summary: This topic outlines the process of cancelling a fee receipt that was incorrectly generated and explains where to view cancelled receipts within the system.
steps: Locate the specific fee receipt that needs to be cancelled.
Select the option to cancel the receipt.
Provide a mandatory 'Remark' explaining the reason for the cancellation.
Save the cancellation to complete the process.
business_rules: A 'Remark' (reason) is mandatory when cancelling a fee receipt.
important_notes: Cancelled receipts will be recorded and can be viewed in the 'Cancellation Report' by filtering the status to 'Cancel'.
Cancellations may also be reflected in the 'Daily Fee Report'.
questions: How do I cancel a fee receipt?
Where can I find a list of cancelled fee receipts?
Is it necessary to provide a reason when cancelling a receipt?
What reports show cancelled fee transactions?
